title: Distributed Energy System Design including Unbalanced AC Power Flow for Large LV Networks with ADMM
summary: With the addition of large numbers of distributed energy resources (DERs) to distribution networks comes the increasing risk that their operation may violate the safety constraints of these networks. The problem considered in this paper is that of combined siting, sizing and dispatch of these DERs, also known as distributed energy system (DES) design, to help meet electrical and heat loads within the network.
